name: Jerome Arfouche
summary: Jerome Arfouche is a web developer based in Montreal who designs and builds websites and apps, primarily with Laravel, Vue.js/Nuxt, and Kirby CMS. Work spans REST APIs to full sites and apps. Outside of development he is a cyclist, musician, reader, and photographer.
targetAudience: People looking to hire or collaborate with a web developer, or view his projects and photography work.
primaryCapabilities: Website and web app development (Laravel, Vue.js/Nuxt, Kirby CMS)
